verdict.rationale: Lead routing applies to a CRM like HubSpot, but the evidence pack never mentions assigning leads to owners, assignment rules, or round-robin rotation. The only related evidence is generic workflow automation ('Create workflows in HubSpot to automate your processes'), which is an adjacent feature and does not document lead routing itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin
